# AggreGate — Pakistan University Merit & Aggregate Calculator

> Free interactive calculators for Pakistani university admission aggregates (merit), with official 2026 formulas, worked examples, program-wise closing merits for 2024 and 2025, a reverse "what test score do I need" calculator, and FAQs. Formulas last verified September–October 2026 against official university admission portals.

## Main calculator

- [All universities merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/): calculate admission aggregate for NUST, FAST, COMSATS, UET, GIKI, PIEAS, LUMS and 21 more Pakistani universities.

## University calculators (formula + closing merit 2024-2025 + FAQs each)

- [NUST merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/nust-merit-calculator): Matric 10% + Inter 15% + NET 75%. Computing closing merit 76.50% (2025).
- [FAST merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/fast-merit-calculator): NUCES aggregate formula and program weightages.
- [COMSATS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/comsats-merit-calculator): COMSATS admission aggregate formula.
- [UET Lahore merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uet-lahore-merit-calculator): ECAT-based aggregate formula.
- [Air University merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/air-university-merit-calculator)
- [UAF merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uaf-merit-calculator)
- [Punjab University merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/punjab-university-merit-calculator)
- [UET Taxila merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/uet-taxila-merit-calculator): University of Engineering and Technology Taxila — official formula HSSC-I 50% + TCAT/ECAT 33% + SSC/Matric 17%, with engineering eligibility and FAQs. Closing merits omitted pending verified publication.

## Medical universities (MDCAT / NUMS)

- [KEMU merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/kemu-merit-calculator): King Edward Medical University — Matric 10% + FSc 40% + MDCAT 50% (MDCAT out of 180). 2025 closing 94.88%.
- [DUHS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/duhs-merit-calculator): Dow University of Health Sciences — same PMDC formula.
- [NUMS merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/nums-merit-calculator): NUMS Entry Test (out of 200, separate from MDCAT) — Matric 10% + FSc 40% + NUMS test 50%.
- [QAU merit calculator](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/qau-merit-calculator): Quaid-i-Azam University BS — Matric 30% + FSc Part-1 70%, no entry test weighted.

## Data provenance

Aggregate weightages are verified against each university's official admission portal (source links on every university page). Closing merits are compiled from official merit lists. Formulas can change between admission cycles; pages carry a "last verified" date.

## Board results 2026 (dates, status, SMS codes, how to check)

- [All board results 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/): status of 9th, 10th, 11th and 12th class results for Punjab, Federal (FBISE), Karachi (BIEK) and KP boards, with SMS codes and checking methods.
- [1st Year Result 2026](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/1st-year-result-2026/): Punjab boards announce 11th class result on 22 October 2026 at 10:00 AM; FBISE announced 9 September 2026; BIEK Karachi group-wise in October 2026; KP boards announced September 2026.
- [Punjab board results](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/punjab-boards/): all 9 BISE boards — 10th class 6 Aug 2026, 9th class 2 Sep 2026, 12th class 23 Sep 2026, 11th class 22 Oct 2026; SMS codes (Lahore 800291, Gujranwala 800299, Multan 800293, Faisalabad 800240, Rawalpindi 800296, Sargodha 800290, DG Khan 800295, Bahawalpur 800298, Sahiwal 800292).
- [Karachi board result (BIEK)](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/karachi-board/): HSC Part-II announced group-wise Aug–Sep 2026 (Commerce 14 Sep 2026); Part-I Pre-Engineering 2 Oct 2026, Pre-Medical Oct 2026; SMS roll number to 8583; biek.edu.pk.
- [Federal board result (FBISE)](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/federal-board/): HSSC Part-I and Part-II announced 9 September 2026, 11:30 AM; SMS "FB <roll number>" to 5050; fbise.edu.pk.
- [KP board results](https://pakistan-merit-calculator.vercel.app/results/kp-boards/): BISE Bannu and BISE Swat HSSC results announced September 2026; SMS roll number to 9818; new IBCC grading (40% passing, A++ to U).
